snippet.title: Vaunted - Announcement Trailer | Xbox Partner Preview 2026
snippet.description:
Vaunted is coming to Xbox on PC and PC Game Pass!

The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.
